sourceFull: Data: Deccan Herald (Apr 2025); Flyvbjerg & Gardner, How Big Things Get Done

segs.text: A metro line in Bengaluru was promised for twenty twenty. It's twenty twenty-six, and it still isn't carrying passengers.
parts: A metro line in Bengaluru was promised for twenty twenty.
It's twenty twenty-six, and it still isn't carrying passengers.

segs.text: Meanwhile, barricades, dust and diversions become part of daily life, for years.
parts: Meanwhile, barricades, dust and diversions become part of daily life, for years.

segs.text: Big projects don't stall because of one thing. It's land, permits, contractors, utilities, funding and trains, each waiting on the other.
parts: Big projects don't stall because of one thing.
It's land, permits, contractors, utilities, funding and trains, each waiting on the other.

segs.text: And it isn't just Bengaluru. Studies of thousands of big projects worldwide find that more than nine in ten run over budget, over time, or both.
parts: Studies of thousands of big projects worldwide find that more than nine in ten run over budget, over time, or both.

segs.text: What if every team could see the same plan, in real time?
parts: What if every team could see the same plan, in real time?

segs.text: One live schedule that every contractor updates. Delays flagged the day they start, not the year they're discovered. Progress and spending, open for anyone to check.
parts: One live schedule that every contractor updates.
Delays flagged the day they start, not the year they're discovered.
Progress and spending, open for anyone to check.

segs.text: That's the coordination Omnix is building for. A.L.K.I. to plan and foresee. OmniChain to keep a record no one can quietly edit.
parts: That's the coordination Omnix is building for.
A.L.K.I. to plan and foresee. OmniChain to keep a record no one can quietly edit.

segs.text: No one builds a metro alone. It takes engineers, workers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
parts: No one builds a metro alone.
It takes engineers, workers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.

segs.text: Planets don't collide, because each one moves in step with the others.
parts: Planets don't collide, because each one moves in step with the others.

segs.text: Promised for twenty twenty. Let's make the next promise one we can all watch being kept.
parts: Let's make the next promise one we can all watch being kept.
